description: What a document window may use: Tauri's core defaults; dragging and titling the window, closing it after asking about unsaved edits, and bringing it to the front to ask; the open and save dialogs; reading the clipboard's text, for Paste as Plain Text; the five file commands the app calls (read a file, ask whether a file exists, write a text file, watch and unwatch), with the file plugin's denials of the webview's own data. Nothing of the updater: the app checks for, downloads and installs an update itself, for every window (src/updates.rs), and a window only asks it to, through the app's own commands. Reading, asking and writing reach no file by themselves, only the files the person opened or saved: the app adds each to the scope, as the dialog plugin does for a file picked in an open or save dialog (src/file_scope.rs). Watching reaches the home folder and every folder in it except hidden ones too, for a document is watched through its folder.
